project_context.arch:
MTOP is Moral Topology, a standalone application in the Social Tools family.
Canonical package: _application/moral_topology, a local Dash application. space.py
defines four illustrative axes; levers.py defines 25 conditions and five traits;
forces.py and dynamics.py own the headless numerical mechanism; scenarios.py holds
21 authored cases; comparison.py creates reproducible paired interventions;
figures.py, guided.py and app.py render the guided and full-model workspaces.
Assets are local. The runtime has no database or trading dependency. The shared
cross-op register is project coordination only. _source is immutable input.
The project stays in its current folder and owns an independent local Git repository.
project_context.core:
A consumer-facing decision-mapping studio: make the assumptions behind a
judgement discussable. Choose a situation, change one condition and read how its
modeled configuration shifts across scope, binding, processing and foundation tilt.
Mechanism inspection and accessibility are the purpose; the historical cases are
retained as illustrations. Numerical values are authored assumptions, not fitted
sociological measurements or moral verdicts. Guided comparisons and the independent
full-model sandbox serve first-use explanation and deeper exploration respectively.
Future direction is comprehension testing before expanding authoring or sharing.

rows.body:
User approved the MTOP Social Tools identity and keeping this folder.
Keep the standalone runtime outside trading/UMG families. Preserve _source and all
historical/research-inspired case examples. Do not read cold storage without an
explicit request. Use the shared 0_Codex venv; ask before installing packages.
Decision coordinates and indices are illustrative; positive is not morally better,
cohort percentiles are not confidence intervals, and endpoint clusters do not prove
stable attractors. Comparisons must pair starts, traits and random draws. Initial
force components are not endpoint attribution. Model iterations are dimensionless;
event/export timestamps use integer ts_ms epoch milliseconds. Keep all full-model
control panes mounted for cross-tab callbacks; k=0 must remain zero. Runtime setup
and validation recipes live in _documentation/plumbing.md.

rows.re: Test first-use comprehension with new users
rows.body: Future product evidence: observe new users identifying the changed input, reading the four coordinate changes, and distinguishing an illustrative configuration from a moral verdict or behavioral forecast. Record misunderstandings before expanding case authoring or public presentation. This is not a blocker for the local demonstrator.

rows.re: Measure numerical sensitivity before stronger dynamical claims
rows.body: Future analysis: compare horizons, step caps, integration intervals and clustering tolerances before presenting stable equilibria or robust quantitative effects. Current home-anchor updates are discrete and not dt-invariant; fixed pulls and finite endpoint clusters remain assumption experiments. No empirical calibration is claimed.
